answer_1.quote: We present baseline WinoQueer results for a variety of popular LLMs, as well as demonstrating that anti-queer bias in all studied models can be partially mitigated by finetuning on a relevant corpus...
tasks: Other: bias probing in language models
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates language models' tendency to generate stereotypical or biased sentences in a controlled probing setup, which involves generating sentence likelihoods under different identity conditions.

answer_2.quote: Evaluation on WQ follows the methodology of ..., which introduced a novel pseudo-log-likelihood metric for bias in masked language models.
automatic_metrics: bias score (percentage of cases where stereotypical sentence is more likely)
